subject.title: fix(signal): expose mention facts in inbound context

question: Should the public inbound context keep current main's `GroupRequireMention` as the canonical require-mention field, or should this PR introduce a new `RequireMention` field or alias?
rationale: This PR changes public prompt/plugin context shape, and current main already added a same-semantics field, so automation should not choose the permanent API name without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep `GroupRequireMention` Canonical
options.body: Rebase the branch, drop the duplicate `RequireMention` field, and add only the missing detection/any/effective/skip facts around the existing policy field.

options.title: Approve A New Alias
options.body: Keep `RequireMention` only with explicit docs/tests explaining the alias or replacement relationship to `GroupRequireMention`.

options.title: Pause API Expansion
options.body: Leave the PR draft until the mention-facts context contract is redesigned with the predecessor stack.

recommendation.title: Keep `GroupRequireMention` Canonical
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, drop the duplicate `RequireMention` field, and add only the missing detection/any/effective/skip facts around the existing policy field.

likelyOwner.reason: They own much of the inbound context builder/mock history and are the strongest routing candidate for the public context shape decision.
